name: 185 Promotions & Apparel
old_description: Swag. Promos. Branded giveaways. Whatever you call it, we make it unforgettable!
about:
Based in Carmel, Indiana, with a second office in Bloomington, 185 Promotions & Apparel is a woman-owned promotional products company that has been serving clients for over two decades. The business was founded as a woman-owned enterprise (WBE) and has built its reputation on promotional expertise.

The company sources and customizes a wide range of promotional merchandise, including apparel, bags, writing instruments, tech products, and drinkware. Its services encompass custom company stores, school spirit-wear websites, branded kits, and unique merchandise programs. In-house capabilities include custom t-shirt design and embroidery, allowing clients to add logos and artwork to stock items.

185 Promotions & Apparel works with corporate clients needing branded merchandise for employee stores and with educational institutions seeking spirit wear for students and alumni. The firm also assembles custom kits for events, onboarding, and marketing campaigns, serving organizations that require turnkey promotional solutions.

The company emphasizes a customer-focused approach, highlighting its team’s problem-solving mindset and commitment to innovative solutions with exceptional service. Its woman-owned status and deep promotional experience are presented as key differentiators in a crowded marketplace.
